claim_or_scope: Coverage of W: every unit of the complete frozen official source file (headers, title, citations, recitals, enacting formula, 5 chapter headings, 29 articles with their paragraphs, points and sub-points, final formula, 37 footnotes, 5 annexes with their items and table rows) is inventoried and screened in source order.
search_description: Mechanical parse enumerated units; the executor then read the text of every unit in source order and screened each (UNIT_SCREENING); a mechanical check confirmed that every text node of the source file is contained in some unit (only list markers, and image-only paragraphs of Annex I carried as image placeholders, are not text units). Statements, assignments, positions, relations and external references come from the executor reading. Instruments outside W were not searched.

claim_or_scope: Coverage of sources outside W: no instrument outside W was retrieved, read or searched (GAP-04); every reference made in W to an outside source is recorded as an EXT record (not_checked; outside_corpus_not_expanded).
search_description: References were collected by reading every unit; the referenced sources themselves were not opened. Annex I formula images were viewed only in part (three of six image units) and are not transcribed.

claim_or_scope: Within SC-01, no position other than the Commission holds competence to decide on, approve, reject or require changes to a Plan or an amended Plan.
search_description: Reading of all units for decision, approval, rejection, requirement and agreement competences relating to Plans: Commission (A17.P1, A17.P3(c), A18.P3, A18.P4); Member State and Commission by agreement on the assessment deadline (A16.P1). No competence of the Council, the European Parliament, consultative committees or stakeholders to approve or reject a Plan was found. "Not found" is a statement about the search of W, not about the law; the adoption procedure of implementing acts is not stated (see CL for implementing acts).

claim_or_scope: Within SC-03, no position other than the Commission holds competence to authorise, suspend, reduce, terminate or pro-rate payments of financial allocations.
search_description: Reading of all units for payment-related competences: Commission (A20.P3, A20.P4, A20.P6, A20.P7, A20.P9, A20.P10, A21.P4); Member States only request, observe and are assessed. No other position was found within W; the Financial Regulation rules on disbursement are outside W.

claim_or_scope: The procedure for adopting the implementing acts and individual decisions of the Commission (committee involvement, voting) is stated within W.
search_description: All units were read for procedural rules on implementing acts (A17.P1, A18.P3, A20.P3); none states a committee or adoption procedure. The procedure, if any, lies outside W and is not cited.

claim_or_scope: No private or self-regulatory body holds assessment, decision, standard-setting or enforcement competence within W.
search_description: Reading of all units for competences of non-public bodies: private entities appear as intermediaries and recipients (A9.P1, A23.P2) and as parties under Union rules only; none holds a competence of the listed kinds in W.

claim_or_scope: No review, appeal or independent adjudication body for decisions of the Commission under W is stated within W.
search_description: Reading of all units for review or appeal competences: the Member State has the possibility to present observations (A18.P4, A20.P4, A20.P6, A20.P7, A21.P4) but no review body is named. Judicial review under the Treaties is outside W and not cited.

claim_or_scope: Within the Union, the Article 17 decision is a necessary stage for every payment of Fund resources to a Member State and no alternative payment route exists.
search_description: Reading of A7, A10-A12, A14, A17, A19-A21 and Annexes I-II: payments are tied to A17/A19/A20 where those provisions apply, but A11.P1 states that resources transferred to the Fund are implemented directly by the Commission without cross-reference to A17-A20, and the Financial Regulation and Directive 2003/87/EC rules on funding and payment are outside W. Neither necessity nor substitutability can be asserted.

claim_or_scope: No numeric threshold, weight or scoring rule is stated within W for "complies satisfactorily" (A17.P3), the criteria of A16.P3, "satisfactorily achieved" (A20.P2) or "tangible progress" (A20.P7).
search_description: Reading of A16, A17 and A20 and of the Annexes: percentages appear for cost caps (A8.P2, A8.P3, A11.P4), the national contribution (A15) and minor adjustments (A18.P6) but not for the assessment standards listed.

claim_or_scope: No accountability capacity of the European Parliament over the Commission implementation of the Fund beyond A25.P3, A26 and A27 is stated within W.
search_description: Reading of all units for forum, assessment and consequence elements toward the European Parliament: only invitations (A25.P3, A26.P1), the duty to take account (A26.P2) and reports (A27) were found. The discharge procedure referred to in A21.P3 (Article 319 TFEU) is outside W and its capacities are not stated.

claim_or_scope: The European Parliament, the Council, the European Economic and Social Committee and the Committee of the Regions, as recipients of Commission reports under A25 and A27, hold no assessment, approval or sanction capacity over those reports within W.
search_description: Reading of A24-A27 and the whole instrument for any follow-up capacity of these recipients: none found; the Commission is only required to take account of views expressed in the dialogue (A26.P2).

claim_or_scope: The rule-making position (the legislator enacting W) is not a party of any qualified relation of W.
search_description: All relations were recorded from the text; none has the European Parliament and the Council acting as rule-makers; the European Parliament and Council appear only as recipients of information and as dialogue partner.

claim_or_scope: No explicit legal link is stated within W between the Article 24 monitoring reports and the Article 20 payment assessment (payment depends on milestones and targets of the Plan and the Commission decision, A20.P1-P2).
search_description: Reading of A20, A24 and A17: A20.P2 refers to milestones and targets set out in the Commission decision under Article 17; A24 reports are not mentioned in A20; the Plan and the decision must contain monitoring arrangements and the Annex IV indicators (A6.P1(m), A17.P2(d)-(e)), which is an interface between the two sets of provisions.

claim_or_scope: No subconfiguration is warranted for the information and communication provisions of A23, for the delivery relations of A9 and A11(3), or for the A25 transmission and the A25(3) invitation taken together with A26: each rests on a single relation or on thematic proximity without a stated legal coupling.
search_description: Reading of A9, A11(3), A23, A25, A26: a single qualified relation does not make a subconfiguration (RGAM-DR-23); the A25 provisions and A26.P1 concern the same recipients and the same subject (the Plans and their assessment) but no provision couples them.
